  context={"endpoint"}

Downloads Linkiir's signed list of published catalogs and reports which
are already on this grid and which this grid's version can use.

A POST because it reaches out to download.linkiir.com, which only happens
when an operator asks. Installing one is a separate subscribe_catalog.
